## 5. Droop mitigation ladder (s = 10 dec/V, 99.9 %, room temperature, 1 pF)

Hold time = static spec / droop. *Best circuit*: no ESD on the hold node (internal node, no pad) and the better of 0 / 0.3 V gate underdrive. *Centred*: each sample pre-offset by half the expected droop (2×). *Compensated*: the expected droop is subtracted (feed-forward, from time since refresh), leaving a fraction u of it; u is an assumption (10 %, 1 %), not a measurement. Electrodes per DAC line: an upper bound from droop alone, centred hold time / 1 µs slot.
